name: The Theatre Club and Its Double
source:
It's a tale as old as time. Boy meets girls. Girls stage a Theatre show. And there's cake. It is a heartbreaking tale of old friendships, new love, and dramatic theory. There are ups and downs and stage rights and lefts, and true and false exits.

Through it all, always remember one of the oldest sayings in the Theatre. Even if you forget your lines, the technician missed her cue or s̶o̶m̶e̶o̶n̶e̶ ̶d̶i̶e̶s̶ ̶o̶n̶ ̶s̶t̶a̶g̶e̶ a prop breaks: [b]The show must go on[/b].

[From [url=https://mariehatch.itch.io/the-theatre-club-and-its-double]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个古老得不能再古老的故事。男孩遇见女孩们，女孩们筹备一出舞台剧，还有蛋糕。旧日友情、新生爱意与戏剧理论交织成一段令人心碎的故事。其中有起起落落，有舞台左右，也有真真假假的退场。

无论发生什么，请始终记住剧场里一句古老的格言。即使你忘了台词，技术人员错过了进场信号，或̶人̶死̶在̶舞̶台̶上̶道具坏掉了：[b]演出必须继续[/b]。

[摘自[url=https://mariehatch.itch.io/the-theatre-club-and-its-double]Itch.io[/url]]
